Sound Familiar?

You’re not making it up. And you’re not overreacting.

If any of this hits home, you’re exactly where you should be.

“Just rest and take it easy” is not a plan. You deserve actual guidance.

  • Your lower back aches by mid-afternoon, and sleeping through the night feels like a distant memory.
  • You leak a little when you sneeze, laugh, or cough, and you’ve been told that’s “just part of pregnancy.”
  • You’ve read the horror stories about your abs separating, and you don’t know what’s safe to do about it.
  • You were active before. Now you have no idea which workouts are safe this trimester, so you do nothing and feel worse.
  • Your ankles are swollen, your shoes are a battle you can no longer see, and everyone’s advice is “it’ll pass.”
  • Your OB visits are 15 minutes, weeks apart, and every question in between gets answered by Google at 2am.
What We’ll Work On

Real problems. A real plan. A real doctor.

Not generic advice: a program built around your body and the exact week of pregnancy you’re in.

Protect your core & belly

Diastasis recti (abdominal separation) is what those horror stories are about. The wrong ab exercises from YouTube can actually make the coning and doming worse. We’ll strengthen and coordinate your core the right way, now and through every trimester, so your body is set up to carry your baby and recover after.

HowGuided core & pelvic floor training that changes as your belly grows. No guesswork.

Stay dry & confident

Leaking when you sneeze, laugh, or exercise is common, but common isn’t the same as “nothing can be done.” Your pelvic floor can be trained like any other part of your body, and pregnancy is the best time to start, not the worst.

HowPelvic floor retraining matched to your symptoms and stage. Most women notice change in weeks.

Move, sleep & feel like you

Back pain, hip and pelvic girdle pain, the 2am position shuffle: we’ll relieve what hurts and teach you (and your partner) exactly what helps: positioning, safe movement, hands-on techniques you can do at home.

HowRelief techniques, sleep positioning for your exact bump size, and movement you can trust.
What It’s Actually Like

You’re never left to figure it out alone.

One flat membership. Everything included. Here’s what that means on a random Tuesday.

Unlimited video visits

See your doctor as often as this season requires

Once a week, three times a week, whatever your body is asking for. No per-visit charges, no waiting rooms, no childcare logistics. Just you and Dr. Lakshmi on video, from your couch.

“My back spasmed picking up laundry and I panicked.” → Same-day video visit. Relief positions that afternoon.

Direct messaging

A doctor in your pocket, not a search bar

Something feels off? Message Dr. Lakshmi directly. She reads every message herself and replies within hours, never longer than a day. No more crowdsourcing your body from strangers on the internet.

“Is this pressure normal at 28 weeks, or should I worry?” → A real answer from your own doctor, not page 4 of a forum.

Your exercise plan, on video

Prescribed for the exact week you’re in

This isn’t a video library you have to sort through. Dr. Lakshmi prescribes your specific exercises, safe for your trimester, your symptoms, and your fitness level, as follow-along videos with your sets and reps built in. She sees what you did and how it felt, and adjusts before you even ask.

Press play, put the phone down, follow along. Whether it’s the gym or the bedroom floor at 6am.

Weekly check-ins

Someone is checking on you, every week

Even if you don’t reach out, Dr. Lakshmi does: at minimum once a week, every week of your pregnancy. Not to grade your workouts. Just to make sure you’re okay, answer what’s on your mind, and adjust the plan as your body changes.

The kind of care you’d want for your own sister, from someone with a doctorate.

Messaging and video visits are for guidance and support. They’re not for emergencies and don’t replace your OB or emergency care. If something urgent is happening, call your physician or 911 first.

Week by Week

A plan for every week of pregnancy, and after

Your body changes every week. Your plan should too.

First trimester

Build the foundation: core and pelvic floor coordination, safe strength work, and habits that make the next six months dramatically easier, even on the mornings you feel awful.

Second trimester

Adapt as your center of gravity shifts: protect your abdominal wall as your belly grows, keep training the movements you love, and get ahead of back and pelvic pain before it starts.

Third trimester

Comfort and preparation: sleep positioning, pressure and swelling management, partner techniques for real relief, and getting your body ready for delivery day.

Fourth trimester

You’re not dropped at delivery. Postpartum recovery, healing your core, returning to running and lifting, with the doctor who already knows your whole story.

Already 20 weeks? 30? You can start at any point. Dr. Lakshmi meets you exactly where you are and catches your body up from there.

Questions

Everything you’d want to ask first

How much does it cost?

$289/month, flat. That includes unlimited video visits, direct messaging, your personalized exercise program, and weekly check-ins. No per-visit charges, no add-ons, no surprises. Sessions are FSA and HSA eligible.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Month to month, cancel whenever you want, no contracts and no cancellation fees. Most moms stay through delivery and postpartum recovery (because it keeps working), but that’s your call, always.

Do you take insurance?

Thrive is a cash-pay practice by design: that’s what makes unlimited visits and direct access to your doctor possible. Insurance-based PT pays per visit, which is exactly why those clinics can’t message you back between appointments. Your membership is FSA/HSA eligible, and many plans reimburse out-of-network PT; Dr. Lakshmi can provide documentation.

I’m already well into my pregnancy. Is it too late to start?

No. Whether you’re at week 8 or week 34, Dr. Lakshmi starts with a full evaluation of where your body is right now and builds your plan from there. Starting earlier gives you more runway, but starting today always beats not starting.

How is this different from a pregnancy app?

Apps give everyone the same content. Dr. Lakshmi prescribes your exercises after actually evaluating your body, and she sees your feedback after every session, adjusts your plan, and answers your specific questions. An app can’t tell you whether that twinge is normal. Your doctor can.

What happens on the free consult?

It’s 15 minutes on video with Dr. Lakshmi herself. Tell her what’s going on, ask anything, and she’ll tell you honestly whether she can help. No card required, no pressure. If it’s not a fit, you’ll leave with useful direction anyway.

Is this a substitute for my OB?

No. Dr. Lakshmi works alongside your OB or midwife, not in place of them. She covers the movement, pain, core, and pelvic floor side of pregnancy that a 15-minute OB visit doesn’t have room for. Anything medical or urgent always goes to your physician first.
